description: Record queue writes as the ring program receives them and the applications that fold them into the 4-ary member record tree. A member or register-key write's member is owner_identity(signer), an escrow key is Poseidon(nullifier_pk, hash_bytes(ciphertext)), an entry hash is Poseidon(CRQW, member, mask, value, escrow_key, mint_policy_write, withdrawal_threshold, limits_0, limits_1, limits_2, address_hash) and chain(p) = Poseidon(chain(p - 1), entry_p) from chain(-1) = 0. The writes of an application are its pending writes then its authority writes, each with the apply circuit's proof inputs. Paths list three siblings per level, leaf level first, in ascending child order. Produced by program-libs/member-registry/tests/ring_records_vector.rs.
